gen-gf-klee-one-satoshi: Satoshi has a soaring x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut. Satoshi's uniform stroke width makes a tidy foil for the casual handwriting of Klee One.
gen-gf-klee-one-switzer: Klee One writes casually, with terminals cut well short of the bowl. Switzer's plain sans build, tubular and wire-like with a tall waist line, gives that loose hand a crisp frame.
gen-gf-klee-one-work-sans: Klee One is at its best when friendly and handwritten, its terminals cut short of the bowl. Work Sans takes the sturdier job, a sans-serif with a high mean line and c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-konkhmer-sleokchher-gf-graduate: Graduate is a serif with generous space between letters and little gap between capitals and lowercase. Graduate's bookish dignity lets the commanding Konkhmer Sleokchher headline stand out without a fight.
gen-gf-koulen-gf-graduate: Koulen packs bold display letters tight, with bowls that never thin at the sides and a lowercase nearly cap-sized. But Graduate gives the tension a way out: bookish, dignified, with generous white between its letters.
gen-gf-lacquer-author: Author reads refined, with a slight swell on its bowls, and works well for a quick paragraph. Author does the patient, dignified work, while Lacquer saves its bold, commanding voice for curves that open outward.
gen-gf-lacquer-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Lacquer is bold and commanding, its curves opening outward instead of curling in. BhuTuka Expanded One, literary and curvy, slows the pace to a leisurely walk beside that loud opener.
gen-gf-lacquer-gf-kiwi-maru: Curves that open outward instead of curling in give Lacquer its bold, commanding stance. Kiwi Maru's pen-like line of constant weight is the quiet thing that holds the pair together.
gen-gf-lacquer-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart, with a pipe-cleaner feel and open counters leading outward. Stint Ultra Expanded holds an authoritative, traditional line beside Lacquer, whose bold curves refuse to curl in.
gen-gf-lakki-reddy-fs-sentient: Sentient reads sophisticated and contemporary, its pinched, closed-in apertures best enjoyed a paragraph at a time. But over pages it would feel tighter, while the open, hand-drawn Lakki Reddy keeps things relaxed.
